document.abstract: Author: Ievgen Kostiukevych The Joint Task Force on Networked Media (JT-NM) is an industry-wide effort driven by user communities and supported by several key technical organizations in the media industry. Sponsored by the Advanced Media Workflow Association (AMWA), the European Broadcasting Union (EBU), SMPTE, and the Video Services Forum (VSF), it has acted as a driver for open, interoperable standards for professional media during the transition to the Internet Protocol (IP) infrastructure.
